title: Anti-ICE Protests Erupt in New York After Man Shot Near Child
detail: Anti-ICE protests broke out in New York City after a man was shot while in a car with his child, with demonstrators linking the incident to heightened ICE enforcement activity in the city. Protesters gathered to denounce what they described as a climate of fear created by aggressive immigration enforcement operations.
